definitions.explanation: Being defeated and dropping out of a competition; losing and being forced to retreat or exit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{準決勝|じゅんけっしょう}→準決勝：04911_junkesshou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{敗退|はいたい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They were eliminated in the semifinals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦{候補|こうほ}→候補：02804_kouho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦まさか→まさか：03732_masaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一回戦|いっかいせん}→一回戦：08960_ikkaisen⟧{敗退|はいたい}。
examples.english: The tournament favorite was shockingly eliminated in the first round.

examples.japanese: ⟦ワールドカップ→ワールドカップ：27456_waarudokappu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{予選|よせん}→予選：04745_yosen⟧{敗退|はいたい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: They were knocked out in the World Cup qualifiers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{選挙|せんきょ}→選挙：03303_senkyo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{敗退|はいたい}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引退|いんたい}→引退：01848_intai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He retired from politics after losing the election.

notes:
{敗退|はいたい} means being defeated and leaving a competition.

ETYMOLOGY:
{敗|はい} (defeat) + {退|たい} (withdraw) - defeated and withdrawing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {敗退|はいたい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to be eliminated, to lose and exit
- ⟦{一回戦|いっかいせん}→一回戦：08960_ikkaisen⟧{敗退|はいたい} - first-round elimination
- ⟦{予選|よせん}→予選：04745_yosen⟧{敗退|はいたい} - elimination in qualifiers
- ⟦まさか→まさか：03732_masaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{敗退|はいたい} - a defeat nobody saw coming

USAGE:
Commonly used in sports, tournaments, and elections. Implies not just losing a single match but being knocked out of the overall competition.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {敗退|はいたい} vs. ⟦{敗北|はいぼく}→敗北：12872_haiboku⟧: {敗退|はいたい} implies exit from the competition; ⟦{敗北|はいぼく}→敗北：12872_haiboku⟧ is defeat in general, after which the contest may go on
- {敗退|はいたい} vs. ⟦{脱落|だつらく}→脱落：23109_datsuraku⟧: both mean dropping out; {敗退|はいたい} is specifically through defeat, while ⟦{脱落|だつらく}→脱落：23109_datsuraku⟧ can be for any reason (injury, withdrawal, falling behind)
